### Welcome to Open Austin onboarding 
Welcome to Open Austin's onboarding checklist. Go ahead and submit this ticket as-is to get started on onboarding tasks. 

### Join our tools 
- [ ] Join the Open Austin Slack - [invite link](https://join.slack.com/t/open-austin/shared_invite/zt-1xrl6n1fo-5E7~JqTv1bdq5liqLuEXnQ) 
- [ ] Turn on notifications for channel of the Community of Practice you align with - [instructions](https://slack.com/help/articles/360056534254-Manage-notifications-for-specific-channels-and-direct-messages) 
- [ ] Optional: Follow Open Austin on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/open-austin/) and/or [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/open_austin). We don't have a newsletter. 

### Tell us about yourself 
- [ ] Choose and create your contributor profile. You're responsible for updating it throughout your time at Open Austin. 
  - [Designers](https://github.com/open-austin/practice-designers/issues/new?assignees=jcklpe&labels=design%2Ccontributor+profile&projects=&template=design-contributor-profile.yaml&title=%7BYour+Name%7D%3A+Design+Contributor+Profile) 
  - [Developers](https://github.com/open-austin/practice-devs/issues/new?template=contributor-profile.yaml) 
  - [Data scientist](https://github.com/open-austin/practice-data-nerds/issues/new?template=contributor-profile.yaml) 
  - [Product/project manager](https://github.com/open-austin/practice-product/issues/new?template=contributor-profile.yaml) 
- [ ] Introduce yourself in #general on Slack. Optional: Include your contributor profile
- [ ] Join the volunteer roster by sending a message to #oa-admin: _I’m a new YOUR ROLE and I attended DATE org intro. My email address is EMAIL ADDRESS._ 

### Get started building tech for good 
- [ ] Join your Community of Practice channel and turn on notifications 
- [instructions](https://slack.com/help/articles/360056534254-Manage-notifications-for-specific-channels-and-direct-messages) 
- [ ] Explore [open roles](https://github.com/orgs/open-austin/projects/6)
